findings.title: Non-deterministic hash calculation for Issues
findings.message: The hash of the physical promotion identity depends on the order of 'Issues'. If the generator does not provide a deterministic order, the hash will change across runs even if the content is identical, breaking the stability of the sealed identity.
findings.suggestion: Sort the 'Issues' slice by a stable identifier (e.g., ID or alphabetical message) before computing the hash to ensure the output is deterministic.

findings.title: Redundant file reads of METRICS.json in test loop
findings.message: The 'METRICS.json' file is read multiple times within a nested loop in 'TestPublishedV23Inventory' and is subsequently read again by 'verifyManifest'. This causes unnecessary I/O overhead.
findings.suggestion: Parse 'METRICS.json' once and pass the resulting object to 'verifyManifest' or cache the data to avoid redundant disk access.
